text:
Kathy takes the Miami condominium by right of survivorship. Bill signed and delivered the deed, and they were married, so it was a completed lifetime conveyance to them as tenants by the entirety. The prenuptial agreement waived only rights arising from the marriage, such as the pretermitted-spouse share and elective share, and it doesn't undo a gift Bill chose to make. Tommy takes the Deerwoods pasture, Julie's devise of the condo fails, and Tommy and Julie split the rest of the estate equally.

CONFIDENCE: 80
